note: Approvals for migrations that were already applied when the safety check was introduced. Read scripts/migration-safety.mjs for why this file exists rather than markers in the files themselves.

approvals.reason: A backfill, not a deletion. The migration adds RefreshToken.usedAt and sets it from revokedAt for tokens already revoked with reason 'rotated', so reuse detection reads a consistent history for tokens issued before the column existed. It writes to one new column, touches no other data, and is idempotent.
